| caption = This page in a nutshell

*{{{3}}}}}|{{{1}}}}}
}}<noinclude>

==Location==
This infobox template presents a concise summary at the top of [[:Category:Wookieepedia policies and guidelines|Wookieepedia policy and guideline]] pages. It is placed below the title and other infoboxes and above the first paragraph of the main body. 

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>nutshell|text}}</code>

or

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>nutshell<br />
|First bullet point<br />
|Second bullet point<br />
|Third bullet point}}</code>

[[Category:Header templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
